cases.name: CHK-001 happy: story_discard requires explicit confirm before execution
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-discard-guard-')); try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'index.json'), JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-test', name: 'tmp', title: 'tmp', description: 'tmp', type: 'bug', phase: 'DEV', priority: 'high', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), endedAt: null }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'checklist.json'), JSON.stringify({ items: [] }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; try { execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'story_discard', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-test' })], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { blocked: false, phaseStillDev: false }; } catch (error) { const text = String(error.stderr || error.stdout || error.message || error); const story = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'index.json'), 'utf8')); return { blocked: text.includes('危险命令') && text.includes('--confirm'), phaseStillDev: story.phase === 'DEV' }; } } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: fixture_batch_add dry-run previews without requiring confirm
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-fixture-dryrun-')); try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const out = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'fixture_batch_add', JSON.stringify({ fixturePath: 'dry-run-test', dryRun: true, cases: [{ name: 'case-1', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] })], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const target = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures', 'dry-run-test.json'); return { mentionsDryRun: out.includes('[DRY-RUN]'), fileStillMissing: !existsSync(target) }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: confirm executes story_discard after preview
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-discard-confirm-')); try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'index.json'), JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-test', name: 'tmp', title: 'tmp', description: 'tmp', type: 'bug', phase: 'DEV', priority: 'high', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), endedAt: null }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'checklist.json'), JSON.stringify({ items: [] }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const preview = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'story_discard', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-test', dryRun: true })], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const real = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'story_discard', JSON.stringify({ storyId: 'B-test', confirm: true })], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const story = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', 'B-test', 'index.json'), 'utf8')); return { previewMentionsDiscard: preview.includes('mark story phase as DISCARDED'), realMarkedDiscarded: story.phase === 'DISCARDED' && real.includes('已标记为 DISCARDED') }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: fixture_batch_add dry-run and execute stay aligned
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-fixture-exec-')); try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const payload = { fixturePath: 'exec-test', dryRun: true, cases: [{ name: 'case-1', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] }; const preview = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'fixture_batch_add', JSON.stringify(payload)], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const real = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'fixture_batch_add', JSON.stringify({ ...payload, dryRun: false })], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const target = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures', 'exec-test.json'); return { previewPlannedOne: preview.includes('would add 1/1'), realAddedOne: real.includes('Added 1/1') && existsSync(target) && JSON.parse(readFileSync(target, 'utf8')).cases.length === 1 }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
